bindings.title: Supported Message Broker Integrations
bindings.description: Explore AsyncAPI protocol bindings for Kafka, AMQP, MQTT, SQS, SNS, and more. Learn to define channel, operation, message, and server bindings for event-driven APIs

bindings/amazon-sns.title: Amazon SNS Integrations
bindings/amazon-sns.description: Amazon SNS is a web service that coordinates and manages the delivery or sending of messages to subscribing endpoints or clients

bindings/amazon-sqs.title: Amazon SQS Integrations
bindings/amazon-sqs.description: Amazon SQS lets you send, store, and receive messages between software components at any volume, without losing messages

bindings/amqp.title: AMQP 0-9-1 Integrations
bindings/amqp.description: AMQP 0-9-1 is a binary messaging protocol and semantic framework for microservices and enterprise messaging

bindings/amqp1.title: AMQP 1.0 Integrations
bindings/amqp1.description: AMQP 1.0 is an open, standard wire-level messaging protocol approved by OASIS and ISO/IEC that enables the transfer of messages between peers. Unlike older versions like AMQP 0-9-1, it operates on a peer-to-peer model without a fixed broker topology

bindings/anypointmq.title: Anypoint MQ Integrations
bindings/anypointmq.description: Anypoint MQ is a multi-tenant, cloud-based message queuing service for exchanging data asynchronously between your applications

bindings/apache-kafka.title: Apache Kafka Integrations
bindings/apache-kafka.description: Apache Kafka is an open-source distributed event streaming platform used by thousands of companies for high-performance data pipelines, streaming analytics, data integration, and mission-critical applications

bindings/apache-pulsar.title: Apache Pulsar Integrations
bindings/apache-pulsar.description: Apache Pulsar is an open-source, distributed messaging and streaming platform built for the cloud

bindings/googlepubsub.title: Google Cloud Pub/Sub Integrations
bindings/googlepubsub.description: Pub/Sub works as a messaging middleware for traditional service integration or a simple communication medium for modern microservices

bindings/ibmmq.title: IBM MQ Message Broker Integrations
bindings/ibmmq.description: IBM MQ is a secure, reliable message-oriented middleware that lets independent software systems connect and share data using messages and queues

bindings/jms.title: JMS Message Broker Integrations
bindings/jms.description: The Java Message Service (JMS) API is a messaging standard that allows application components based on the Java Platform Enterprise Edition (Java EE) to create, send, receive, and read messages. It enables distributed communication that is loosely coupled, reliable, and asynchronous

bindings/mercure.title: Mercure Message Broker Integrations
bindings/mercure.description: Mercure streams real-time updates from your servers to any client. It is a fast, reliable, battery-efficient replacement for WebSockets and every library, framework, or hosted service built on top of them

bindings/mqtt.title: MQTT Message Broker Integrations
bindings/mqtt.description: Lightweight, publish-and-subscribe network protocol for the Internet of Things (IoT) that introduces reason codes, user properties, and message expiration

bindings/mqtt5.title: MQTT v5.0 Message Broker Integrations
bindings/mqtt5.description: Lightweight, publish-and-subscribe network protocol for the Internet of Things (IoT) that introduces reason codes, user properties, and message expiration

bindings/nats.title: NATS Message Broker Integrations
bindings/nats.description: NATS unifies messaging, streaming, and state into one real-time system — connecting services, devices, and AI agents from cloud to edge

bindings/solace.title: Solace Event Broker Integrations
bindings/solace.description: Solace Event Broker is a complete event streaming solution that enables the design, deployment, and operation of Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) across hybrid cloud, multi-cloud and IoT environments

bindings/stomp.title: STOMP Integrations
bindings/stomp.description: STOMP (Simple (or Streaming) Text Orientated Messaging Protocol) provides an interoperable wire format so that STOMP clients can communicate with any STOMP message broker to provide easy and widespread messaging interoperability among many languages, platforms and brokers

bindings/websockets.title: WebSockets Integrations
bindings/websockets.description: WebSocket is a computer communication protocol providing full-duplex, two-way interactive communication over a single, persistent TCP connection. It eliminates HTTP request-response overhead, enabling real-time data flow for clients and servers

schemas.title: AsyncAPI Schemas - Data Definition and Validation for Event-Driven APIs
schemas.description: Learn about AsyncAPI Schemas, how they define and validate message payloads in event-driven APIs using JSON Schema and other formats like Avro, XML, and Protobuf
